title: Normalized clauses for integral, rational and common-stage isomorphism transport
statement: Fix a prime l, finite coefficient fields E and L over Q_l, and an isomorphism g:X→Y of schemes with l invertible, together with the stalk-unit proofs hX,hY. Use the completed integral and raw rational categories, their prescribed pullbacks and scalar comparisons of [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed, def-weil-rationalization-karoubi, def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], and the normalized lambda and epsilon of [lem-pod-pullback-identities-scalar-extension]. IsomorphismFieldTransportStage packages: the coefficient projection equation; additive exact inverse equivalence on completed module sheaves with its specified module counit; the integral equivalence, normalized lambda, compatible shift, linearity, exactness and normalized epsilon; and the rational equivalence, additive object and tensor-arrow formulas, localized shift/exactness and localized epsilon. isomorphismFieldTransportScalarLaw is the integral equation alpha_inv, followed by inverse pullback of alpha_g, followed by epsilon_L, equals scalar extension of epsilon_E, as an equation of whole ambient derived arrows. isomorphismFieldTransportRationalScalarLaw is the corresponding equation on every rational object using the stage's normalized rational epsilon. For an algebraic closure Ω and a family of finite stages indexed by its small finite coefficient models, IsomorphismFieldTransportCommon packages the equivalence, additive exact compatible shift, identity-normalized inclusion comparisons, the prescribed object/representative formulas and the own-stage epsilon formula on the actual common-stage category of [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients]. These are exactly the four original auxiliary declarations of lem-pod-isomorphism-field-transport, extracted unchanged into a shared module; no new mathematical notion or unproved object is selected.
